Generalizable lesson saved:
For early-1939 weekly Capital Movements questions, especially Latin America net inflow/outflow over date intervals, use the printed regional “net total capital movement” value for the exact interval. Do not stop at or recompute from the liquid/banking-funds subtotal; nearby subtotals can look plausible but omit components such as brokerage balances or security transactions.
